findings.title: Existing-entry updates preserve the old modality and bypass the rule gate
findings.evidence: The gate checks incoming modality at 88; the update branch at 94-97 changes content, version and attestation but never entry.modality.
findings.trigger: Insert an attested DeonticRule, then insert the same key with EpistemicFact and has_biometric_attestation=false.
findings.impact: The stored entry remains DeonticRule with replacement content and no attestation. Conversely promoting an existing fact with an attested rule leaves it typed as a fact. This is a local buffer invariant failure; downstream effect authorization was not established.

findings.title: State commitment omits boundaries between key and content
findings.evidence: state_digest feeds k.as_bytes() immediately followed by entry.content.as_bytes(), without lengths or separators (144-145).
findings.trigger: Compare singleton buffers with key="a", content="bc" and key="ab", content="c", and identical modality/version/frequency/attestation.
findings.impact: Different buffer states feed identical bytes to BLAKE3 and therefore have equal commitments without breaking the hash. The digest cannot uniquely bind the represented state.

findings.title: Zero-capacity governance buffer still accepts an entry
findings.evidence: new accepts max_capacity=0 (56-60); insert evicts an empty map when len>=0 and then inserts unconditionally (101-114).
findings.trigger: Construct SessionGovernanceBuffer::new(0) and insert an EpistemicFact.
findings.impact: The buffer returns success and contains one entry despite its configured zero capacity. CapacityExceeded exists but is never returned.

findings.title: Counterexample learning returns success without persisting feedback
findings.evidence: The public learn_from_failure function promises persistence in its docstring (18), but its entire implementation is logger.info followed by return True (20-21); it is re-exported by verification/__init__.py.
findings.trigger: A caller invokes learn_from_failure with a verification counterexample expecting the documented durable feedback.
findings.impact: The caller receives success although no cortex memory operation occurs; feedback disappears when logging is disabled or logs expire. No active production caller was established.
